en.title: Global Wealth Flow Monitor — 12 October 2026
en.deck: Long-term U.S. fund flows turned slightly negative as ETF issuance fell short of mutual-fund withdrawals; money-market assets rose to $7.96tn and gold ETFs still attracted inflows.
en.regime: Long-term U.S. fund flows turned slightly negative as ETF issuance fell short of mutual-fund withdrawals; money-market assets rose to $7.96tn and gold ETFs still attracted inflows.
